parents.course: Issues in Intercollegiate Athletics: The Big Ten Conference

ns2:section.sectionText: 1st 8 week course. This course examines the history of the Big Ten Conference, and its impact on the evolution of college and all sports. It will focus on challenges and key decisions, game-changing innovations, and even controversies and missteps that have enabled the Big Ten Conference to grow and prosper.
